ICC Approves Pink Ball for Day Tests, Implements New Rules

The International Cricket Council (ICC) has approved the use of the pink ball for day-night Test matches. Additionally, new regulations have been introduced, including a five-run penalty for batsmen who waste time. These changes aim to modernize the game and address player conduct.
